faithfulness_scope: independent deterministic mirror of the repository experiment; local execution was not a direct execution of the committed repository file

execution.local_mirror_note: Same SplitMix64 generator, 48/4/16/24/16 geometry, seven AR(0.35) feature sources, exact last-origin rank-one adversary, and per-origin/pooled singular-ratio calculations.

interpretation.finding: A pooled SVD can remain apparently well-conditioned while one actual rolling training window is singular. The conditioning policy must therefore be origin-local, with the aggregate decision failing closed if any required forecast origin is inadmissible.
